label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value depends on user input (param from request.getParameter). While param.replace("\"", """) encodes double quotes, it does NOT encode < > & ' which allows script injection via angle brackets (e.g., ">><script>...</script>"). Attacker-controlled data reaches the HTML output unsafely.

evidence.note: User input param flows to bar with incomplete sanitization (only \\" replaced), then bar embedded in HTML attribute data-name allowing XSS
